context:
Update the shared DataFrame mixin load path to always attempt
prepare_benchmark_data() when prefer_parquet is enabled, regardless of
sharded list paths. Remove the sharded-list bypass guard and normalize
returned paths before load_table calls.

Enforce fail-fast behavior if Parquet prep fails in prefer_parquet mode to
prevent silent CSV fallback. Introduce a cache version bump in data_loader so
stale pre-fix conversion artifacts are not reused. Keep
core/runner/dataframe_runner.py semantics aligned with the mixin path.
description:
DataFrame benchmarks with sharded source paths (list-valued benchmark.tables)
are bypassing DataFrameDataLoader.prepare_benchmark_data() in
benchmark_mixin.py. This causes adapters (notably Polars) to load raw
CSV/TBL shards instead of converted Parquet and leaves date columns typed
as strings.

Resulting failures include date comparison errors and year extraction errors
in TPCH queries (e.g., Q6/Q9/Q14/Q20). The defect was introduced when
sharded-path handling changed the Parquet prep guard to skip preparation
whenever benchmark.tables contains list values.

anti_patterns.dont: invalidate caches via ad-hoc rm logic in runtime code
keep list-path-specific bypass guards for Parquet prep
anti_patterns.instead: always route prefer_parquet flows through prepare_benchmark_data()
anti_patterns.why: they reintroduce CSV scans on common sharded datasets

anti_patterns.dont: silently warn-and-fallback to CSV when Parquet prep raises
anti_patterns.why: this hides correctness defects and leads to date-type regressions

preserves.behavior: DataFrame adapters keep load_table(ctx, table_name, file_paths, column_names) contract unchanged
Existing DataFrame benchmark result schema and phase reporting remain unchanged
prefer_parquet=false continues to load source CSV/TBL files without conversion
